english.title: Travel beyond the distance paid for on railway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having paid your fare for a journey between **(..SPECIFY FIRST LOCATION..) and **(..SPECIFY SECOND LOCATION..), knowingly and wilfully proceeded by train beyond the distance paid for and without previously paying the additional fare for the additional distance and with intent to avoid payment thereof.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(3)(b) of the Regulation of Railways Act 1889.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having paid fare for a journey
knowingly and wilfully proceeded by train
beyond distance fare paid
without paying additional fare for additional distance
with intent to avoid payment

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) If no intent to avoid the fare can be proved, consider subsection 5(1) fail to show ticket, pay fare, give name and address.
(ii) If the fare to the more distant station does not in fact involve an additional fare, then the the offence is not made out. (R v FRERE (1855) 24 LJMC 68).

other.powersofarrest:
In England and Wales: Arrest without warrant .

In Scotland: Common Law powers of arrest apply.
other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment or a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
